title: DIF: A Framework for Benchmarking and Verifying Implicit Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM performance on mathematical reasoning datasets by assigning racial and ethnic personas (e.g., Asian, Black, White) in the system prompt and measuring the variance in the sets of correctly answered questions using the Demographic Implicit Fairness (DIF) metric.

Evaluating LLM performance on mathematical reasoning datasets by assigning religious personas (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Atheist) in the system prompt and measuring the variance in the sets of correctly answered questions using the Demographic Implicit Fairness (DIF) metric.

Evaluating LLM performance on mathematical reasoning datasets by assigning disability status personas (e.g., Able-bodied, Physically disabled) in the system prompt and measuring the variance in the sets of correctly answered questions using the Demographic Implicit Fairness (DIF) metric.
